dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: A great black whale in the open seas... Yes, this will surely be a bestseller!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: My name is Nantuck, one of the people in charge of the Mondstadt Fishing Association.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Huh, from the looks of you, you appear to have recognized me for my other role. Ah, so this is the frightening power of fame, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Well then, there's no point pretending. That's right! The famed sea-life author Nantuck — that's me!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: ...Eh? You've never read anything I've ever written? Well, that's because I haven't published anything yet. But fret not! A great work by yours truly will soon sweep across the literary markets, that much I can guarantee.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: And if you'd like, I'd happily put you first in line when my first signing session comes up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you mean by "a giant black whale"?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Shh! Softer, please! This is my magnum opus in progress we're talking about here!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Well, since you seem interested, allow me to give you a sneak peek.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Imagine this: an epic tale on the high seas, with a heroic fisherman pursuing a giant black whale! This'll be a bestseller for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: But don't you breathe a word of this to anyone, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Such glorious inspiration cannot be reclaimed, should they be lost to someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy some fishing supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Well, I've got some of the Association's stock right here. Have a look and see if any of them meet your needs.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: See you. Haha, this idea will be popular, I'm sure of it!
